name: lolisuki18-skills
description: Agent skills for development, pull requests, QA and documentation workflows.

plugins.name: dev-workflow-skills
plugins.description: Eleven agent skills from idea to audited code: lifecycle, plans, tests, audit, bug investigation, refactor, security review, migration, code explainer performance profiling and CI/CD setup.

plugins.name: pull-request-skills
plugins.description: Nine agent skills for the life of a pull request: commit messages, PR descriptions, self-review, reviews, replies, CI triage, merge conflicts, PR splitting and code comments.

plugins.name: qa-workflow-skills
plugins.description: Ten agent skills for the software testing life cycle: test plan, test matrix, E2E, API, non-functional, regression, accessibility, defects and summary report with a Go/No-Go verdict.

plugins.name: docs-workflow-skills
plugins.description: Thirteen agent skills for documentation written from real code: README, diagrams, API docs, ADRs, changelog, runbook, postmortem, SDLC reports and the Review 2 package.

plugins.name: ai-workflow-suite
plugins.description: Delivery orchestrator (build, pull request, QA, docs, release) plus shared conventions for the four skill repos.
